Offer 03

The same wine list,
twice the margin

Most wine lists on the island are built from a catalogue: famous regions, famous grapes, a price the guest can check on their phone. You pay for the reputation and the guest pays for it too — but the margin in the middle is thin. We build the list the other way round: from the cost-in up.
1
We read your current list and your menu. What sells, what sits, what your kitchen needs a wine for.
2
We pick by cost-in, not by prestige. Less-famous regions and indigenous grapes carry no price expectation — the guest judges what is in the glass, and blind, these over-deliver.
3
We write and design the card. Tasting notes, food pairings, your branding, printed and ready. In English plus Russian, Thai or whatever your room speaks.
4
We arm the floor. Tent cards, neck tags, a 20-minute briefing so your team can sell the second glass.

Offer 04

We become a wine bar
inside your venue

For two evenings we move in: a mobile wine station, the whole selection and a sommelier who stands by the wine and talks to your guests. You sell through your till, under your licence, and keep the mark-up. You buy nothing and you pre-pay nothing.
1
We set up the station in a corner of your room or at the entrance, dressed for the event.
2
The wine arrives on consignment. Bottles to sell whole, plus light wines for the glass. Open a glass bottle and it is yours at cost — the rest you sell at leisure.
3
The guest orders from you and pays you. Your till, your licence. Our sommelier does the talking and the pouring.
4
We settle afterwards on what actually sold. Unopened bottles leave with us, free of charge.

Next step

Three steps,
no commitment

Nothing here needs a decision today. The first step costs you twenty minutes and tells you exactly what the numbers would look like in your room.
1
Twenty minutes at your venue. We look at your wine list, your menu and your room, and ask what your guests actually order.
2
We come back with a proposal. The SKUs that fit your concept with cost-in prices, the margin delta on your current list position by position, and — if the room suits it — a date and a plan for an evening.
3
You pick what you want. A few new lines on the list, a rebuilt card, an event weekend, or all three. One page of paperwork, samples arranged for the SKUs you shortlist.
